scope: Controlled local Store snapshot/SQL-observer admission only. No decoded media or transport-cell qualification.
problem: A capture can select a later SQL observer while earlier ones are busy, release SQL for file admission, then choose a now-free earlier observer. The current seal correctly rejects connection-local counters from that different observer, producing an avoidable authority-busy refusal despite an unchanged original observer being available.
required_behavior: Release SQL completely during the original full file admission.
Immediately reacquire only the original SQL observer; do not substitute another connection or compare its counters.
Refuse if that observer is busy, runtime ownership changed, or the original data/schema/version changed.
Preserve exact current authority scopes, policy clock and source/credential checks, with no partial or idle reader on refusal.

after.scope: Affected Store snapshot, ownership, fence and native-stream cases only. Not the full Store suite or decoded runtime quality.
after.change: Fresh file admission releases SQL as before. Reacquisition immediately selects the original captured observer, preserving connection-local counter comparisons. Other free observers cannot validate it; a busy original observer, current ownership refusal or changed SQL/schema/clock still refuses.

runtime_verification.status: Original normal optimized build active after successful Store prerequisites; same native quality comparison queued.
